data: LibriSpeech dev-clean long concatenations (benchmarks/prepare_long_asr.py); set 1 speakers 1272,1462,2035; set 2 speakers 1673,1988,1993,2078
method: Same suite through each build; WER from the benchmark runner (english_case_punctuation normalization, so 'mister' vs 'mr' counts as an error in every variant).
finding: No accuracy gain over the old windows is established. 25 s chunks skipped one 23-word sentence in 7 clips; a words-per-second check with a half-split re-decode recovered it. 15 s chunks avoided the skip but scored worse on set 2. Differences outside that skip are within noise for this sample size.
